signature.name: VTask.copy
signature.type: {ι : Type u_1} -> {A : Type u_2} -> {B : Type u_3} -> {σ : Type u_6} -> {τ : Type u_7} -> [Semiring A] -> [Semiring B] -> [SetLike σ A] -> [SetLike τ B] -> {𝒜 : ι → σ} -> {ℬ : ι → τ} -> (f : 𝒜 →+*ᵍ ℬ) -> (f' : A → B) -> (h : f' = ⇑f) -> 𝒜 →+*ᵍ ℬ

conventions.statement: The result of VTask.copy f f' h is propositionally equal to f as a GradedRingHom, i.e., VTask.copy f f' h = f.
conventions.note: This holds regardless of the choice of f', as long as h witnesses f' = ⇑f.

conventions.statement: The coercion of VTask.copy f f' h to a bare function is exactly f', i.e., ⇑(VTask.copy f f' h) = f'.
conventions.note: This is the defining purpose of the copy construction: the new term carries f' as its underlying function.

facts.statement: ∀ {ι : Type*} {A : Type*} {B : Type*} {σ : Type*} {τ : Type*} [Semiring A] [Semiring B] [SetLike σ A] [SetLike τ B] {𝒜 : ι → σ} {ℬ : ι → τ} (f : 𝒜 →+*ᵍ ℬ) (f' : A → B) (h : f' = ⇑f), VTask.copy f f' h = f
